name: g_system
summary: Resident System object (0x8e5c bytes on the heap). +0x1 SLZ context, +0x4 graphics, +0x10 Loader (table of contents at +4 / +0x4804), +0x5a20 handoff registry, +0x5aa4 sound system

name: g_rng_table
summary: ran3 state (index 1..55 used)

name: g_rng_index
summary: ran3 position

name: g_rng_seed
summary: Last seed passed to rng_seed (0x4e421714 at boot)

name: g_cd_bytes_left
summary: Bytes still to read for the current load

name: g_cd_dest
summary: Destination pointer for the next sector

name: g_loader_busy
summary: Nonzero while a read is active

name: g_cd_target_loc
summary: BCD position the drive seeks to

name: t_system
summary: System object as seen by program #1

name: t_loader
summary: System + 0x10

name: t_slz_ctx
summary: System + 1 (first argument of slz_unpack)

name: t_sound
summary: System + 0x5aa4

name: t_handoff
summary: System + 0x5a20

name: f_system
summary: System object as seen by program #3100

name: f_loader
summary: System + 0x10

name: f_handoff
summary: Inter-program handoff registry

name: f_sound
summary: Sound system (music / effects)

name: script_globals
summary: Script global variable memory, byte-addressed. Word 0 is the VM return register

name: script_flags
summary: Script global flag bits (bit n = byte n>>3, bit n&7). Event / chest state lives here

name: game_state
summary: +0x08/+0x0c/+0x10 arrival position for map transfer, +0x1c current music, +0x24 leader actor index, +0x180 48 words of script-visible values, +0x248/+0x24a/+0x24c 16-bit counters (0x248 changed by add_money)

name: game_counters
summary: +0x14 program-swap counter, +0x18 counter clamped 0..999999999, +0x1c/+0x20/+0x24/+0x28/+0x2c readable counters, +0xe8 12-byte rows

name: party_table
summary: 0x60 bytes per slot. +0x00 s16 character id + 1 (negative = inactive?), +0x22 s16 maximum, +0x24 s16 current (HP?)

name: character_records
summary: 0xd0 bytes each. +0x0c..+0x18 seven s16 equipment slots, +0x1a s16 capped at 999, +0x3c / +0x5c byte arrays, +0xcc two bytes

name: inventory
summary: Item entries: bits 0-9 item id, bits 10-14 count

name: field_actors
summary: Field actors indexed by script actor number; +0x00/+0x04/+0x08 position (<<12 fixed point)

name: message_windows
summary: Message windows indexed by window number

name: field_system
summary: Map / field system object

name: message_system
summary: Message system

name: field_flags
summary: Field-mode flags (+0x10 controlled actor, +0x26 input lock, +0x68 ...)

name: music_table
summary: Script music numbers (< 100) map through this table

name: map_transfer_table
summary: Map ids for map_transfer_table (ext 0xbb)

name: vm_args
summary: Scratchpad buffer vm_fetch_args fills

name: g_prologue_data
summary: 0x52800-byte buffer: the prologue's first part (#2680 Claude / #2681 Rena) preloaded during name entry

name: g_text_x
summary: Next free texel column of the New Game text line buffer

name: g_text_line
summary: First texel row of the current text line

name: g_text_strings
summary: New Game string table (entry #14 block 0)

name: g_text_font
summary: New Game font (entry #14 block 1)

name: g_text_pixels
summary: 0x8000-byte 4-bit text line buffer (uploaded to VRAM 0x3c0; 0x100)

name: g_battle_rank_unlocked
summary: Set by the Voice Collection (over half the voices heard); adds the Battle Rank screen to New Game

name: g_sound_demo_state
summary: new_game_sound_update step (1 wait; 2 bank; 3 busy; 4 play; 0xff playing)

name: g_load_queue_entry
summary: Background load queue: entries

name: g_load_queue_dest
summary: Background load queue: destinations

name: g_load_current
summary: Entry being read by the load queue (0 = idle)

name: g_cd_slot_bytes
summary: Streaming: bytes per ring slot (the movie player uses 0x5000: ten sectors)

name: g_cd_slot_count
summary: Streaming: slots in the ring (2 for movies)

name: g_cd_slot
summary: Streaming: slot being filled; loader_stream_slot returns the one before it

name: g_cd_stream_headers
summary: Streaming: each sector's 32-byte STR header goes to the slot's header table (0x8002b570) and the rest to 0x8002b574

name: g_cd_defer_sectors
summary: Sectors wait while set (24-bit MDEC transfers); see loader_defer_sectors

name: g_cd_sector_deferred
summary: A sector is waiting; movie_dma_callback then calls cd_sector_ready_callback

name: g_movie_screen_cleared
summary: Both display buffers were cleared before the first frame

name: g_movie_slice_half
summary: Half of the slice buffer the MDEC fills next

name: g_movie_slice_rect
summary: VRAM column (mode * 8 halfwords x height) the finished slice is loaded to

name: g_movie_slices
summary: Two MDEC output slices of mode * 0xf00 bytes (16 x 240 pixels each)

name: g_movie_frame_count
summary: Frames decoded or skipped since movie_create. The intro and the attract mode start the opening's music once it passes 9; the prologue's cue clock while a movie plays

name: g_movie_frame_ready
summary: A frame is finished and waits for movie_present

name: g_movie_decoding
summary: A frame is going through the MDEC (until movie_present)

name: g_movie_draw_buffer
summary: 0: frames are decoded to y; 1: to y + 240

name: g_movie_rect
summary: x; y; width; height from movie_create

name: g_movie_mode
summary: 3 = 24-bit output; 2 = 15-bit (VRAM halfwords per two pixels)

name: g_movie_frames_in_ram
summary: Decode whole frames to RAM instead of VRAM; cleared by movie_create and never set
